newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Skilled Sept qtr net falls 15.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Skilled Sept qtr net falls 15.3 pct.

text.p: Skilled Engineering Ltd said on Tuesday net profit was 15.3 percent lower at A$2.97 million for the three months to September 30, 1996, while sales revenue rose 13.5 percent to A$81.49 million in the quarter.

"...directors are confident that their strategy of continuing to seek to diversify into new growth business activity will counter balance the impact of the short term economic downturn which is now evident in Skilled's traditional areas of business," Skilled said.

"The company has been looking at a number of growth opportunities, and whilst some have been discarded as not being proper fit with the company, other continue to look particularly attractive, and are being carefully pursued," it said.
It said the double-digit revenue growth was expected to continue.
Skilled Engineering said earnings per share were 4.33 cents in the September quarter, down from 5.12 cents a year earlier.
It said earnings before tax and interest was 5.5 percent lower at A$5.54 million.
The company said its communications division won a A$2.5 million new Optus cable-television contract in Adelaide.
At 11.45 a.m. (0045 GMT), Skilled shares were five cents down at A$4.40.
